stemMd: Fluorescent membrane proteins in a small patch of a living cell are bleached. Fluorescence gradually returns without new protein synthesis. What does this most directly support?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Bleaching of every protein in the whole cell

options.label: D
options.textMd: Conversion of phospholipids into fluorescent proteins

options.label: E
options.textMd: Lateral movement of unbleached proteins into the patch

explanationMd: Unbleached proteins can diffuse laterally from nearby membrane into the bleached region. Recovery without synthesis supports mobility within the membrane; it does not require new protein production.

distractorRationale.d: Lipids do not convert into proteins in this experiment.
distractorRationale.c: Immobility would prevent replenishment from neighbouring membrane.
distractorRationale.b: Nuclear division does not explain local fluorescence recovery.
distractorRationale.a: The stem specifies a small patch.
